turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hello Sofia! How is your Thursday going so far? Did you manage to get some good sleep after your night shift?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi! Yes, I actually slept pretty well today. When I finally woke up, I was craving something freezing, so I poured myself a big glass of the slow-steeped iced coffee I keep in the fridge to help wake me up.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Cold brew is absolutely essential for those hot Phoenix afternoons! Are you heading back into the ER tonight?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I am. It's going to be another busy night, I'm sure. I just finished boxing up some of the extra pasta I made for dinner last night so I have something ready to eat during my break.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Bringing packed leftovers is always a smart move for those long shifts. How have things been with Tom? Have you two had any time for salsa dancing lately?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We actually went out dancing a couple of nights ago! It was incredibly fun, but my feet are still paying the price. Honestly, my legs were too tired to even think about walking to the transit station today, so I just used an app on my phone to hail a driver to take me straight to work.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A rideshare sounds like the perfect treat to save your energy for the hospital floor. Do you usually just relax and listen to something on the way over?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Definitely. Today I queued up a really hilarious audio show where a couple of stand-up comics talk about their most awkward life experiences. It had me laughing the whole drive here.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A good comedy podcast is the perfect way to get into a great headspace before a shift. Did you have any time for sourdough baking this week, or has it been too hectic?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I fed my starter yesterday, but I haven't actually baked anything new. Tom and I are still finishing up the loaf I made last weekend, so no rush on a new batch just yet.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That makes sense, you don't want any of it going to waste. I hope your shift at the hospital goes smoothly tonight!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I'm just pulling up to the entrance now, so wish me luck.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Good luck, Sofia! Stay safe and we'll chat tomorrow.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Will do, thank you! Talk to you then.
